financing.summary: Ashton Woods USA L.L.C. (Ashton Woods Homes and Starlight Homes) is a private, family-owned builder with public Rule 144A notes, so it posts 10-K/10-Q/8-K-style reports on its own site. It is already one of the most option-heavy builders: 87.8% of its 54,317 controlled lots were under purchase or option contracts at Aug 31, 2026, backed by $641.0M of nonrefundable deposits against about $4.0B of remaining purchase price. Corporate funding is three unsecured notes series ($1.2B, first maturity Aug 2029) plus an undrawn $550M Wells Fargo-agented unsecured revolver (Nov 2029); liquidity was $707.1M. Land-banking counterparties are not named in any filing: the company describes sale-and-option-back deals with unnamed investors ($601.2M of real estate not owned), a fast-growing set of investor-funded lot purchase agreements (three at May 31, 2026, ten at Aug 31, 2026), and fifteen lot purchase agreements with affiliates of its owner families. Room for a land banker is in displacing or adding to those unnamed providers rather than converting owned land, since only 6,650 lots are owned.
financing.land_strategy: Land-light by design. The company's stated approach is a 'strategic focus on optioned lots' that keeps unused inventory dollars off the balance sheet (88% optioned at Nov 30, 2025; 87.8% at Aug 31, 2026), buying land only after entitlement. The annual report frames it as a balance between land owned and developed for its own use and lots controlled through option contracts; no numeric optioned-lot target is stated. Its risk factors say it relies on 'land banking' or 'off-balance sheet' arrangements and would be at a disadvantage if they were not available on satisfactory terms.

lots.source_title: Ashton Woods USA L.L.C. Quarterly Report, Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended Aug 31, 2026; not filed with the SEC, posted on company IR site)
lots.note: Lot counts and 87.8% are as stated in the report. years_supply 5.3 is computed here: 54,317 lots / 10,212 trailing-twelve-month closings (FY2026 10,080 + Q1 FY27 2,191 - Q1 FY26 2,059). The company's own stated figure at May 31, 2026 was about 5.5 years (0.6 owned, 4.9 controlled) on 55,718 lots (6,466 owned, 49,252 under contract). Owned 6,650 = 4,487 finished lots + 2,163 lots in land under development or held for future development; a further 3,886 homes under construction or completed are not counted as lots. By segment: East 23,636 controlled (2,871 owned, 20,765 optioned); Central 30,681 (3,779 owned, 26,902 optioned). A year earlier (Aug 31, 2025): 57,973 controlled, 8,662 owned, 49,311 optioned (85.1%). In the three months to Aug 31, 2026 it bought 2,587 lots for $266.6M and spent $75.5M on land development.

land_banking.description: Ashton Woods sells land it owns to investors and concurrently takes a lot purchase option back; because the repurchase is treated as a financing under ASC 606, the lots stay on its balance sheet as real estate not owned. $601.2M of real estate not owned and $457.4M of related liabilities (net of $143.8M cash deposits) at Aug 31, 2026.
land_banking.source_title: Ashton Woods USA L.L.C. Quarterly Report, Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended Aug 31, 2026; not filed with the SEC, posted on company IR site)
land_banking.note: Counterparties are not identified in any company report. Essentially flat versus May 31, 2026 ($601.4M real estate not owned, $444.9M liabilities, $156.6M deposits). Deposits equal roughly 24% of the recorded real estate. No specific-performance obligation; deposits are forfeited if lots are not taken.

land_banking.counterparty: Not publicly named (investors who buy lots the company identifies)
land_banking.description: Classic land-bank structure in the company's words: it identifies lots, finds an investor to buy them, then options them back in staged takedowns for a nonrefundable deposit. Ten such lot purchase agreements (one with owner-family affiliates) were consolidated under ASC 470-40 at Aug 31, 2026: $139.8M real estate not owned and $109.3M of liabilities net of $30.5M deposits.
land_banking.source_title: Ashton Woods USA L.L.C. Quarterly Report, Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended Aug 31, 2026; not filed with the SEC, posted on company IR site)
land_banking.note: Up from three agreements, $90.3M real estate not owned and $66.9M liabilities (net of $23.4M deposits) at May 31, 2026, so seven new consolidated investor arrangements were added in the June to August 2026 quarter. Only arrangements where the company judges itself economically compelled to buy are recorded here; other investor-funded options sit off balance sheet and are not separately quantified.

land_banking.counterparty: Affiliates of the owner families behind Little Shots Nevada L.L.C. (called 'the Investors' in the reports)
land_banking.description: Related-party lot banking: fifteen lot purchase agreements with affiliates of the five families that own 99% of Ashton Woods. Initial deposits were 20% to 30% of the purchase price, with no specific-performance requirement; 3,496 lots remained to be purchased for $106.3M at Aug 31, 2026. Four of the agreements are recorded as real estate not owned.
land_banking.source_title: Ashton Woods USA L.L.C. Quarterly Report, Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended Aug 31, 2026; not filed with the SEC, posted on company IR site)
land_banking.note: At May 31, 2026 it was thirteen agreements, 3,595 lots and about $114.3M (FY2026 annual report). The five families are those related to Elly Reisman, the Estate of Norman Reisman, Bruce Freeman, Seymour Joffe and Harry Rosenbaum. Amounts overlap with the two rows above where the agreements are consolidated.

land_banking.counterparty: Not publicly named (all land sellers, developers and investors under purchase and option contracts)
land_banking.description: Whole option book at Aug 31, 2026: 47,667 lots under purchase and option agreements. Unconsolidated agreements carried $3.2B of remaining purchase price against $467.7M of cash deposits; agreements recorded under ASC 606 or ASC 470-40 carried a further $944.6M against $174.3M of deposits. Total nonrefundable deposits were $641.0M and the remaining purchase price under option agreements with nonrefundable deposits was $4.0B.
land_banking.source_title: Ashton Woods USA L.L.C. Quarterly Report, Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended Aug 31, 2026; not filed with the SEC, posted on company IR site)
land_banking.note: amount_usd_m is the $4.0B remaining purchase price under agreements with nonrefundable deposits. The filings do not split the book between land-banker, developer and land-seller options, and name no counterparty. Deposits average roughly 15% of remaining purchase price on the unconsolidated book and 18% on the consolidated book. The first three rows are subsets of this one.
